summary: ORBITAL is a web-based astronaut health monitoring system designed to support health awareness during space missions. It brings important health indicators such as heart rate, sleep duration, bone density and radiation exposure together in a single dashboard. The system also provides daily health check-in and alert features to help users review health information easily. Our goal is to develop a simple and accessible monitoring platform that can support astronaut health awareness and contribute to safer space missions.
details: Project Overview ORBITAL is a web-based astronaut health monitoring platform developed to support health awareness during space missions. Main Features 1. Heart Rate Monitoring – Displays heart rate information. 2. Sleep Monitoring – Tracks sleep duration. 3. Bone Density Monitoring – Provides a section for monitoring bone-health status. 4. Radiation Exposure Monitoring – Provides an overview of radiation exposure. 5. Daily Health Check-in – Allows routine health updates. 6. Alert System – Highlights information that may require attention. How It Works The platform organizes astronaut health information into different monitoring categories through a centralized dashboard. Users can review health indicators, check daily health updates and view alerts through the web interface. Benefits ORBITAL aims to make astronaut health information easier to access and understand through a single monitoring interface. It provides a foundation for future integration with health sensors and mission data systems. Future Development Future improvements may include real-time sensor integration, health trend analysis, secure health records and advanced alert mechanisms. Technology The project is deployed as a web application using Vercel hosting.
dataRefs: No NASA datasets or NASA resources were used in the current version of this project.
